name: 圣光充能增伤
description: 拥有圣光充能时，造成的伤害提高2点。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.sourcePiece; if (!caster) { return { success: false, message: '' }; } var buff = caster.statusTags && caster.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.id === 'holy-charge-buff'; }); if (!buff) { return { success: false, message: '' }; } if (context.targetPiece && caster.instanceId === context.targetPiece.instanceId) { return { success: false, message: '' }; } if (context.damage !== undefined && context.damage > 0) { context.damage += buff.intensity || 2; buff.remainingUses = (buff.remainingUses || 1) - 1; if (buff.remainingUses <= 0) { removeStatusEffectById(caster.instanceId, 'holy-charge-buff'); removeRuleById(caster.instanceId, 'rule-holy-charge'); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '的圣光充能触发，伤害+' + (buff.intensity || 2) }; } return { success: false, message: '' }; }
